policy: The Parkharfe Olympiapark launch source explicitly states that smartphone direct payment and the SWM charging card use the same 0.49 EUR/kWh AC and 0.69 EUR/kWh DC prices at this location. Exact DE*LIS EVSE identifiers are cross-checked on the current station directory; one AC and one DC EVSE are seeded as conservative station-level evidence. The same ad-hoc tariff is not extrapolated to the wider DE*LIS network until direct-payment equivalence is verified network-wide.
